reviews.review: So, as always, I must note that with Choice of Games, the author matters a lot. Here, the author is Athat Fikry, as a sophomore outing - with the first being the rather excellent The Dragon and the Djinn. Here, however, I really wish there was a neutral option - the game was going fairly well, with a raid on a specific facility feeling like a sort of midpoint or second-to-last-act-action before the reveal, and then it sort of switched focus to hunting down one fellow, very briefly, and then... Ended. I'm not sure if I somehow made choices that meant I didn't get to find things out - I feel like I investigated at most possible turns, but I could be wrong - but it felt truncated. Like the author ran out of time. What was there was nice - so I'm grading it as a I would a good essay that forgot the closing paragraph. C+, a mild recommendation, maybe look at this author's other work first.
